reason: The workstream was instructed not to use a shared browser or start services. Node/static/DOM-double tests are recorded separately and do not constitute browser or assistive-technology observations.

checks.action: Open projects/05-planner/index.html directly from disk with networking unavailable.
checks.criterion: Relative local assets and the original generated bundle load; edit, solve, repair and JSON export work without requests.

checks.action: Use only keyboard to choose a preset, expand tasks, edit fields, solve and approve a repair.
checks.criterion: Visible focus, meaningful labels, logical reading order and no keyboard trap.

checks.action: Load Pocket Arcade, read the original conflict, then approve one offered change.
checks.criterion: 85 minutes in 75 is explicitly infeasible; no partial schedule is drawn. Minimum cost is one field/10 minutes. The approved schedule retains all seven tasks, both breaks and fixed check-in.

checks.action: Load boundary-valid midnight preset, choose the one-node bound, and solve.
checks.criterion: Unproven/unknown wording; no impossibility or minimum repair claim, no invented schedule.

checks.action: Edit after a result; also import malformed and unsupported JSON.
checks.criterion: Editing removes old repair choices and disables analysis export. Failed imports preserve editor/result and focus the error summary.

checks.action: Explicitly export input and analysis, import an exported report, reload after saving.
checks.criterion: Downloaded JSON labels status accurately; imported input round-trips but report conclusions are discarded. Reload does not imply autosave.

checks.action: Read editor labels, errors, status changes, conflict scope, repair objective and timeline with an assistive technology.
checks.criterion: Meaning does not depend on color; status, errors, task names and ordering are understandable.

checks.action: Inspect at 320 CSS pixels and at 200 percent zoom.
checks.criterion: Controls and text are usable, labels readable, time values and task details reachable without obscured content.
